choices.help: The creator's default and the settings of its measurements: MOE_UNION_CAP=48, a cap on the experts the tokens of one decode step may route to together.
choices.label: Quality

choices.help: MOE_UNION_CAP=32: a tighter expert cap, faster with several requests at once; the creator measured a little lower GSM8K and HumanEval scores.
choices.label: Fast

choices.help: MOE_UNION_CAP=0: every token routes to its own experts (KL 0 against the uncapped engine, the creator's figure); slower with several requests at once.
choices.label: Uncapped exact

options.help: The creator's speed and quality preset (MOE_UNION_CAP): how many routed experts the tokens of one decode step may use together. Fewer is faster at several requests at once and loses a little quality.
options.label: Preset
options.name: preset

choices.help: DFlash2 drafting with MTP=2 (the creator's default). The drafter is converted for this rank on the first start.
choices.label: DFlash2

choices.help: The checkpoint's MTP head only (the creator: remove DRAFTER); the DFlash2 files are still downloaded as part of the recipe's model closure but unused.
choices.label: MTP only

options.help: Whether requests draft with IncoAI's DFlash2 drafter (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, non-commercial: licence information only, nothing here enforces it) or with the checkpoint's MTP head only.
options.label: Speculative drafter
options.name: dflash

choices.help: No copies are written: the loader reads the release's files (the creator's boot before its prepare step). Copies an earlier start wrote are still read; they hold the same bytes.
choices.label: Off

choices.help: The first start writes the copies (the creator's prepare step), later starts read them.
choices.label: On

options.help: Dense per-rank copies of each box's expert ranges, written once to the writable cache and read by the loader in place of the release's sparse files (the creator's GR8_LOAD_COMPACT with GR8_LOAD_MERGE_KB=1, already set in the recipe's EXTRA_ENV). Faster restarts; about 70 GiB of disk a box.
options.label: Compact expert copies
options.name: compact
